title: Promoting Retirement-Savings Access for American Workers by Establishing TrumpIRA.gov

enrichment.summary: This order directs the Treasury Department to create an online platform called TrumpIRA.gov that helps American workers, especially those without employer retirement plans, find high-quality, low-cost individual retirement accounts (IRAs). It also ensures eligible contributors can access up to a $1,000 Federal Saver's Match to encourage retirement savings and promotes transparency and protections for these accounts.
potential_concerns: Independent contractors and self-employed workers may face challenges in understanding and navigating TrumpIRA.gov despite increased financial-literacy efforts, limiting effective retirement savings.
Small business owners might experience indirect administrative burdens if encouraged or incentivized to promote the platform among their workers, even though not explicitly required by the order.

Low-income individuals may qualify for the Federal Saver's Match but still struggle to contribute meaningful amounts to IRAs, potentially limiting the practical benefits of the program for retirement-security.

The platform’s reliance on private-sector financial institutions could lead to variability in service quality or hidden fees that may undermine cost transparency and fiduciary protections for working-age adults.

There is a risk that TrumpIRA.gov does not adequately reach marginalized racial/ethnic groups or other underserved communities who lack employer plans, exacerbating existing retirement-saving disparities.
